You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0122.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

args.command:
cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
import numpy as np

rw=Chem.RWMol(); coords=[]; names={}
def atom(name, element, xy, z=0, noimp=False):
    a=Chem.Atom(element)
    if noimp: a.SetNoImplicit(True)
    i=rw.AddAtom(a); names[name]=i
    x,y=xy; coords.append((x*0.0125,-y*0.0125,z))
    return i
def bond(a,b,bt=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(names[a],names[b],bt)
# steroid core atoms (coordinates follow the drawing)
atom('C3','C',(151,667)); atom('O3','O',(48,728)); atom('A2','C',(151,548)); atom('A1','C',(255,488));
atom('J5','C',(359,548)); atom('J10','C',(359,668)); atom('G','C',(255,728));
atom('B6','C',(463,488)); atom('B5','C',(568,548)); atom('B4','C',(568,668)); atom('B3','C',(463,728));
atom('C7','C',(463,367)); atom('C8','C',(568,307)); atom('J13','C',(671,367)); atom('J14','C',(671,487));
atom('D17','C',(786,329)); atom('D16','C',(850,410)); atom('D15','C',(786,522)); atom('O16','O',(955,410));
# methyl substituents, z= +/- indicates solid/hash wedge
atom('Me10','C',(359,425),.85)
atom('Me5','C',(568,430),.85)
atom('Me13','C',(671,282),-.85)
atom('Me4a','C',(211,808),.65); atom('Me4b','C',(300,812),-.65)
# explicit stereochemical H atoms, likewise with out-of-plane component
atom('H10','H',(295,625),-.8,True)
atom('H6','H',(463,590),-.8,True)
atom('H4','H',(520,640),.8,True)
atom('H17','H',(786,329),.95,True)
# acetoxy group
atom('OA','O',(626,704),-.8)
atom('CAc','C',(710,755)); atom('OAcO','O',(770,710)); atom('MeAc','C',(785,804))
# furan ring (kekule connectivity)
atom('F2','C',(821,215),-.85); atom('F3','C',(751,120)); atom('F4','C',(821,20)); atom('OF','O',(937,60)); atom('F5','C',(937,180))
# bonds for A ring
bond('C3','O3',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('C3','A2'); bond('A2','A1',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('A1','J5'); bond('J5','J10'); bond('J10','G'); bond('G','C3')
# B ring
bond('J5','B6'); bond('B6','B5'); bond('B5','B4'); bond('B4','B3'); bond('B3','J10')
# C ring
bond('B6','C7'); bond('C7','C8'); bond('C8','J13'); bond('J13','J14'); bond('J14','B5')
# D ring cyclopentenone
bond('J13','D17'); bond('D17','D16'); bond('D16','O16',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('D16','D15'); bond('D15','J14',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
# substitutions
bond('J5','Me10'); bond('B5','Me5'); bond('J13','Me13'); bond('G','Me4a'); bond('G','Me4b')
bond('J10','H10'); bond('B6','H6'); bond('B4','H4'); bond('D17','H17')
bond('B4','OA'); bond('OA','CAc'); bond('CAc','OAcO',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('CAc','MeAc')
# furan ring
bond('D17','F2'); bond('F2','F3'); bond('F3','F4',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('F4','OF'); bond('OF','F5'); bond('F5','F2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)

mol=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
conf=Chem.Conformer(mol.GetNumAtoms())
for i,p in enumerate(coords): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(*p))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(mol, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('assigned centers initial:')
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
    if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_TriposAtomName') if a.HasProp('_TriposAtomName') else a.GetSymbol(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
# Save initial stereo descriptors by index
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol)
# Embed a conformer respecting stereochemistry
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=122; params.maxIterations=2000
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol,params)
print('embed status',status)
if status!=0: raise RuntimeError('embed failed')
# optimize
if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol):
    props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol)
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol,props)
    print('MMFF initial',ff.CalcEnergy()); ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000); print('final',ff.CalcEnergy())
else: print('no MMFF')
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('final stereocenters:')
for a in mol.GetAtoms():
    if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
# write output
conf=mol.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from mol_0122.png\n')
    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('atoms',mol.GetNumAtoms())
PY

cp /tmp/build.py /tmp/buildmulti.py && python - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/buildmulti.py'
s=open(p).read()
start=s.index("# Embed a conformer respecting stereochemistry")
end=s.index("Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,cleanIt=True,force=True)", start)
new='''# Sample conformers and select the lowest MMFF energy.
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=122; params.maxIterations=2000; params.numThreads=4
ids=list(AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol, numConfs=40, params=params))
print('nconfs',len(ids))
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol)
results=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol, numThreads=4, maxIters=2000, mmffVariant='MMFF94s')
energies=[r[1] for r in results]
mi=min(range(len(energies)),key=energies.__getitem__)
print('energy range',min(energies),max(energies),'best id',ids[mi])
bestid=ids[mi]
'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
s=s.replace("conf=mol.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w')", "conf=mol.GetConformer(bestid)
with open('answer.xyz','w')")
open(p,'w').write(s)
